mentions.name: Multimodal Swarm Management Simulator
mentions.description: This simulator uses an agent to process operator intents, form a swarm, and build missions for a set of drones and other available assets based on their capabilities. It aims to replace the imperative, low-level model of current mission planners used for operating large fleets of platforms.
mentions.problem: Current mission planners for large fleets of platforms have a very imperative model and are too low-level.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying to implement a Multimodal Swarm Management simulator, idea is to use agent to process operator intents, form swarm and build a mission for a set of drones and other available assets based on their capabilities.
